The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 09211 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 21 May - the folder's feast day. Captioned Konstantin and Elena and filed under Category:Icons of Constantine and Helena. The day's line on both doxologia.ro and saint.gr commemorates the equal-to-the-apostles emperor with his mother jointly, so the plate naming both is this folder's own hero; 09212 on the same day is Constantine, Michael and Theodore of Murom, a different Constantine. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
